kind: complete original lantern story via real UI
checks: New game accepts the letter through A-Lan, then a real delivery commission advances the story; only the ordinary ¥900/15-point reward is granted.
Actual landing at stop 8 unlocks Xiaozhi’s lampshade; refresh preserves the handoff, balances and next objective at stop 16.
At stop 16 the pending island event blocks story completion; after resolving it, the garden ending completes once with a title and no extra money, points or random draw.
AI independently accepts its own letter, completes its normal commission and reaches the stop-8 story handoff through the same rules.
Completed ending persists after reload and remains readable at 390px.
Older save without a story ledger loads unaccepted, with no retroactive credit, movement or monetary change.
